attempts.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Create ONE original black-and-white ink LINE DRAWING for a Chinese narrative visual novel chapter-ending CG, wide 16:9 target 1920x1080, one unified cinematic frame, NOT a poster montage, NOT a comic page. Title concept only: "且慢行 / Look closely before moving on"; draw NO text, no UI, no achievement badge.
The two supplied images are identity reference only: image 1 is Chen Ping'an's authoritative face, image 2 his current travel clothes. Preserve the same 20–22-year-old man's slim elongated face, straight brows, narrow natural eyes, understated mouth, black topknot, thin horizontal jade hairpin with delicate curled head, blue-grey SHORT-SLEEVE outer robe over white inner shirt, dark wrist guards. Interpret all in monochrome lines. No backpack because he is staying indoors at night; his waist is outside the crop. Not an idol face.
SCENE: After the rain, a high wooden gallery overlooking the Tiequan River at night. The visual idea is that an immense moving world becomes secondary to one small damaged thing he has finally looked at. This is a restrained, intimate pause, no enlightenment, no magic.
COMPOSITION: a striking close, oblique view ALONG the top of an old wet wooden handrail. The camera is slightly ABOVE the handrail, looking gently down onto its TOP surface, while remaining well below Chen's eye level. The rail is at his natural waist/upper-abdomen height, not chest height; show enough torso to connect shoulder, elbow, wrist and resting hand. The near end of the handrail enters from lower left very large, recedes toward mid-right, dividing foreground from the river. On the near rail at x~0.28,y~0.66 is a single wind-blown bent grass stem with two narrow torn leaves, lying naturally ON the wet wood, a tiny drop held at the torn tip. It is a small stem made legible by proximity, not a giant plant. Close wood grain, water edge and leaf are drawn with exceptionally delicate spare lines.
Chen is BEHIND the railing on the gallery side in the right third, seen from just above the waist to head, a large recognizable three-quarter face turned left and slightly downward, quietly studying that stem. His head at x~0.77,y~0.32, around 15 percent of total frame height; natural youth and lower facial volume as reference. One forearm rests lightly along the rail, hand at x~0.60,y~0.66, relaxed fingers resting near his own body and far from the stem. His eyes guide our attention along the rail toward the grass. Hands anatomically natural, no pointing, grasping, picking up, saving or blessing the plant.
The remaining upper-left and middle-left two-thirds open onto the broad night river and remote inhabited shore. Tiny ordinary roofs and a few quiet window lights, subdued reflection marks stretching along the water; farther bank broken into extremely faint sparse ink lines and open white paper. No bridge, boat, people, mountains or moon required to clutter the view. One dark gallery post at far right anchors Chen's location; no massive architectural frame across the top. The river is wider than the man, but the small leaf is the first focal point then his eyes. Use near/far scale contrast and asymmetry for emotional force.
STYLE: confident expressive Chinese pen-and-ink storyboard linework, semi-realistic young Chinese man, Song-inspired ordinary architecture, clear structural contour, economical hatching only under sleeve and handrail, 60 percent breathing white space. Sharp fragile grass/eye lines against long flowing distant water lines. No grey airbrush fill, no all-over graphite texture, no photorealism, no watercolor color, no ornamental clouds, no effects, no snow, no rainfall (rain has ended), no heroic posing. A complete original story image rather than an establishing shot. Keep bottom edge uncluttered for optional future UI, but draw no UI.
